name: SISO Agent Runtime
summary: The provider-neutral SISO coding-agent application boundary: explicit configuration, safe host launch, profile composition, task control, checkpoints, bounded context, status, and runtime event contracts.

relationships.context: SISO Agent Runtime provides the coding-agent application boundary used within the stack; Herdr remains the independently owned persistent workspace substrate.

evidence.summary: The Runtime host boundary is workspace-neutral; no private Herdr control plane or topology is embedded.

relationships.context: The retired Agent Base source warehouse is preserved as extraction provenance; it is not the canonical Runtime repository or a runtime dependency.

evidence.summary: The shippable application boundary was separated from the mixed warehouse boundary.

Installer, launchers, runtime extensions, application surfaces, nested repositories, package manifests, repository size, and dirty state were read directly. The shippable center is an application/distribution; the surrounding repository is not one coherent Work.
Clean provider-neutral Runtime foundation published with six internal module contracts, five passing behavior tests, publication checks, and explicit parity limits.
Public main matches the pinned clean Runtime extraction; repository tests and publication gates passed.

license.reason: The canonical clean Runtime extraction carries an MIT license at its pinned commit.

evidence.summary: MIT license text reviewed at the pinned canonical Runtime release.

addressable.reason: The public Runtime source is pinned to an exact commit.

archive_downloadable.reason: A public commit-scoped source archive is recorded.

manifest_resolvable.reason: The release resolves to the permanent Runtime Work and one exact artifact.

installable.reason: The dependency-free CLI runs directly on Node.js 20+, but no package-registry or cross-platform installation receipt is recorded yet.

forkable.reason: Public MIT source includes architecture, migration reasoning, fixtures, tests, CLI, and machine-readable contracts.

portable.reason: The core is provider-neutral and uses only Node.js standard libraries, but this release has one operating-system receipt and no production provider adapter receipt.
